lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, I have a feeling he's gonna tell you something like that. I mean, I, I don't believe you believed for any second that she just walked back there and, and allowed herself to get tied up. Then how did he say he did it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did he get her in there?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The truth for Teresa and yourself.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he had her tied up already.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Let's talk about Halloween. That was on Halloween, right? Do you know anything about Steve being into Satan stuff. Did you ever talk about that at all?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he pick Halloween for any reason?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Not that I know of. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When you were doing this planning thing a couple days before, did he talk about that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you actually plan this a couple days before.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: That's true? How did he get Teresa into the house? Did you help him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who helped him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No one.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did he get her in there?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: That had to be a part of the planning, right? Or him telling you later. You're thinking too much Brendan. Any time you don't answer fairly quick that means you're thinking too much. You don't need to think about the truth.
